label: A Large Herbal
summary: A large illustrated compendium of medicinal herbs and plants.

value.text: no. 71, Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military

claims.statement: Entered as no. 71 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "a herbal in large format".

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Hortus sanitatis. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
